description:
Dual motor system with selectable rear-wheel drive, front-wheel drive, or dual drive modes, combined with torque and cadence sensor assist for a responsive and smooth riding experience. Features a peak 5000W output for powerful performance and versatile riding. Factory set to Class 2 (20 mph), with support for Class 1, 2, 3, and unlocked modes.

Quick-fold design for easy storage and transport, combined with a 48V 20Ah removable Samsung battery. In Class 2 PAS 1 mode, using rear motor only or torque mode, the range can reach up to 50–70 miles per charge. Perfect for daily commuting, travel, and flexible riding without sacrificing performance or convenience.

Choose between torque or cadence sensing, allowing the motor to respond either to your pedaling force for a more natural and efficient ride, or to your pedaling rhythm for smooth and consistent power assistance.

Enjoy precise and powerful braking with advanced hydraulic disc brakes. Designed for smooth, reliable stopping power, they provide control and safety in all conditions, ensuring confidence on every ride.

Half-twist throttle delivers smooth, precise acceleration, while the quick switch button lets you easily change drive modes: – (front drive), O (dual motor), = (rear drive). Enjoy better control for starts, hill climbs, and different riding conditions with instant, convenient switching.

The adjustable handlebar, crafted from high-strength aluminum alloy, offers a -30° to +30° angle adjustment, allowing you to customize your riding posture for maximum comfort and control.

Enjoy a dual-crown front fork with lockout, rear suspension, and adjustable handlebars for full-suspension comfort, plus integrated front and rear lights with turn signals for enhanced safety on any terrain.

Soft, supportive, and ergonomically designed for maximum comfort on every ride. Fits most adult bike seats and reduces pressure for long-distance cycling.

Tackle any surface with 26"x4" puncture-resistant fat tires, providing superior grip, stability, and comfort on all terrains—from sand to snow to rugged trails.

Ride safely day or night with an integrated lighting system that includes a powerful front headlight and rear light, both featuring built-in left and right turn signals for enhanced visibility and safer rides.

Full-color LCD dashboard showing real-time riding data including left/right turn signals, headlight status, and total mileage. Easily switch between Class 1/2/3 modes, with multiple riding modes available for different performance and legal requirements, giving you full control and visibility on every ride.
